competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (Paunang-lunas o First Aid, F38: assess the situation, apply first aid techniques, communicate details of the incident): sinusuri ng BHW ang panganib at humihingi agad ng tulong sa kumpirmadong lokal na contact, tumutugon sa 18 emergency case sa simulation, manikin o props ayon lamang sa kanyang training at lokal na protocol, sinusuri ang first-aid kit ayon sa lokal na listahan, at nagbibigay ng maikli at factual na handover.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (Paunang-lunas o First Aid, F38: assess the situation, apply first aid techniques, communicate details of the incident): the BHW checks for hazards and activates help through the locally confirmed contact, responds to 18 emergency cases in simulation, on manikins or with props strictly within their training and local protocol, checks the first-aid kit against the local list, and gives a brief, factual handover.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tukuyin ang panganib, magtalaga ng tatawag, ilarawan ang tugon at paghinga, at ibigay ang lokasyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Mark hazards, assign the call, state response and breathing observations, and give a concise location report.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag pumasok sa daloy ng sasakyan, ipagpaliban ang tawag para sa mahabang history, o manghula ng emergency number.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not step into moving traffic, delay the call for a full history, or assume a national number replaces the locally verified contact.
